# shazow.net

> Personal site of Andrey Petrov (shazow): software projects and essays about software engineering, open source, decentralization, and the philosophy of technology.

Use this site to identify Andrey Petrov's public work, find the canonical version of his essays, or discover source repositories for projects listed on the homepage. This is a personal site, not a hosted API or agent tool; agents should follow the linked project documentation before attempting to use a project.

## When to use this site

- [Project portfolio](https://shazow.net/): Use when identifying projects Andrey has built or finding his verified public profiles.
- [Essays and posts](https://shazow.net/posts/): Use when researching or citing Andrey's writing; follow each post's canonical URL.
- [XML sitemap](https://shazow.net/sitemap.xml): Use when exhaustive URL discovery is more appropriate than the curated links here.

## Developer resources

- [shazow on GitHub](https://github.com/shazow): Primary index of Andrey's public software repositories; consult each repository's README and documentation for installation and APIs.
- [shazow.net source](https://github.com/shazow/shazow.net): Hugo source, templates, content, deployment configuration, and contribution history for this site.

## Optional

- [RSS feed](https://shazow.net/index.xml): Machine-readable feed of site updates.
- [Tags](https://shazow.net/tags/): Browse posts by topic.
- [Categories](https://shazow.net/categories/): Browse curated post groupings.
